title.quote: From Multimodal LLMs to Generalist Embodied Agents: Methods and Lessons
title.justification: Title at the top of the paper
title.value: From Multimodal LLMs to Generalist Embodied Agents: Methods and Lessons

extractions.description: The paper adapts a pretrained multimodal LLM (LLaVA-OneVision) into a Generalist Embodied Agent (GEA) via a multi-embodiment action tokenizer (Residual VQ-VAE), supervised finetuning on 2.2M embodied trajectories across manipulation, navigation, video games, planning and UI control, and a second stage of online RL (PPO with LoRA) in interactive simulators. It evaluates zero-shot generalization across many benchmarks and ablates data mixing, base MLLM choice/size, and online vs offline data.
